title: Editor feedback labels and calibration
description:
Turn editor decisions into better detection.

## Scope
- Label schema: `{policyId, policyVersion, segmentHash, lane, probability, decision: accepted|dismissed|fixed, reason?}` (no raw text required).
- `calibrate(labels)` → per-detector isotonic map (fallback Platt below a minimum count); applied in `check` when supplied in the pack.
- Few-shot retrieval: caller may supply past labeled examples; Limatus selects the most similar per target.
- Offline steering hook compatible with Jev-Flywheel (propose new questions from dismiss reasons).

## Done when
- Calibration measurably reduces ECE on a held-out fixture set.
